purpose: Determine whether the four already-screened local AC1024 visualization drawings contain an inline SAB body-transform witness suitable for advancing transform semantics.

tooling.inventory: dwgread -O JSON; enumerate OBJECTS rows where entity is 3DSOLID; rebuild each inline SAB from the separately reported ACIS BinaryFile signature plus hex payload; parse and project using a temporary C++ program linked against build-gcc/libdxfrw.a.
tooling.projection: For each payload call drw_parseSab, drw_buildAcisModel, and drw_extractAcisBodyWireframes. The scanner marks a row anomalous unless parse succeeds, SAB version is 21500, rooted projection succeeds, and transform state is Absent.
tooling.condominiumRepair: LibreDWG 0.14 emits a bare lowercase nan in one AcDbShSweep numeric field, making its JSON invalid. In memory only, replace bare nan tokens with JSON NaN before parsing; the source DWG and original JSON bytes are unchanged.

scopeLimits: The four local drawings are a bounded corpus subset and their AutoCAD producer metadata is not independently authenticated; no version-wide absence inference is valid.
Parser and rooted-projection success establish neither SAB schema nor transform semantics, placement, units, B-rep validity, native acceptance, output qualification, or support claims.
The temporary JSON files, repaired JSON view, extracted SAB payloads and scanner are not committed; no external DWG/DXF fixture was added.
claimEffect: The four known local visualization drawings are exhausted as AC1024/21500 non-null body-transform sources. The transform lane still requires a new hash-pinned non-null transform witness or an independently qualified generated-placement oracle.
